feat(transient): support right-aligned template

Adds a right_template option to the transient prompt, rendered
right-aligned at the end of the line. Supported in zsh (via RPROMPT)
and pwsh (via cursor save/restore, mirroring writePrimaryRightPrompt).
When a filler is configured it now fills the gap between both parts.

Also guards shouldFill against a negative padding length which would
panic in strings.Repeat.

resolves #4822

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add --allow-remote-refs to disable HTTP fetching of $ref by default (#3051)

* Add --allow-remote-refs flag to gate HTTP fetching of $ref targets

Remote $ref fetching over HTTP/HTTPS is now disabled by default.
When a $ref resolves to an HTTP(S) URL and --allow-remote-refs is not set,
a clear error message is shown instead of silently fetching remote content.

file:// URLs are still allowed without the flag since they are local.
--url input implicitly enables --allow-remote-refs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Improve error message for missing local $ref files

When a $ref points to a local file that doesn't exist, the error now
clearly states "$ref file not found: <path>" instead of raising a raw
FileNotFoundError.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Validate HTTP responses before parsing as schema content

Check status codes and Content-Type headers when fetching remote $ref
targets over HTTP. Returns clear error messages for HTTP errors (4xx/5xx)
and unexpected HTML responses instead of cryptic YAML parse errors.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Remove redundant local `import json` in test functions

The module-level import already covers these usages.

Fix CodeQL code scanning alerts (#36858)

Fixes 10 CodeQL code scanning alerts:

- Change `NewPagination`/`SetLinkHeader` to accept `int64` for total
count, clamping internally to fix incorrect-integer-conversion alerts
([#110](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/110),
[#114](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/114),
[#115](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/115),
[#116](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/116))
- Use `strconv.Atoi()` in `htmlrenderer.go` to avoid int64 intermediate
([#105](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/105),
[#106](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/106))
- Clamp regex match indices in `escape_stream.go` to fix
allocation-size-overflow
([#161](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/161),
[#162](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/162),
[#163](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/163))
- Cap slice pre-allocation in `GetIssueDependencies`
([#181](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/security/code-scanning/181))

refactor: split monolith into workspace with core/cli/wasm crates

Flatten wakaru-rs/ into repo root and split the single crate into three:

- wakaru-core: pure transform logic, WASM-safe by design. Parallelism
  opt-in via `parallel` Cargo feature (gates rayon). Sourcemap accepted
  as Option<Vec<u8>> instead of file path.
- wakaru-cli: clap + rayon + filesystem I/O. Enables core's parallel
  feature for native performance.
- wakaru-wasm: thin wasm-bindgen bindings over core with hand-written
  TypeScript definitions. Skeleton ready for wasm-pack build.

Key changes:
- DecompileOptions.sourcemap_path -> sourcemap (raw bytes)
- Sourcemap parsed once before Phase 2 loop (was per-module)
- extract_sources split: pure extract_source_entries in core,
  fs writes in CLI
- Two-phase unpack pipeline stays in core with cfg-gated par_iter
- Renamed tests/fixtures -> tests/bundles
- Updated CI workflows, docs, npm package, generate scripts

All 987 tests pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(api): detect wildcard CORS origin by membership, not exact match

A mixed config such as CORS_ORIGINS="*,https://app.example.com" (or an
accidental trailing comma "*,") produced a list that contained "*" but was not
exactly ["*"], so the previous equality check re-enabled credentials. Starlette
treats any allow_origins list containing "*" as allow-all, so those configs
reintroduced the arbitrary-origin credentialed CORS behavior this fix prevents.

Test "*" membership instead of list equality, and drop empty origin entries in
get_cors_origins() (falling back to ["*"] if nothing remains). Add regression
tests for the mixed-wildcard and trailing-comma cases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: map confirmation isNonConsequential in AI capabilities extension (#7857)

* feat: map confirmation isNonConsequential in AI capabilities extension

The x-ai-capabilities confirmation object supports isNonConsequential
(plugin manifest 2.4), but Kiota dropped it: the ExtensionConfirmation
parser only read type/title/body and the generated manifest confirmation
was never populated with it. Parse, write, and map isNonConsequential to
the manifest Confirmation.IsNonConsequential property.

Assert the serialized output contains "isNonConsequential":true rather than just
the property name, so the test fails if the value is emitted incorrectly.

feat(dashboard): add 4 visibility tabs — Activity, Quality, Memory, Goals (#49)

Extends the dashboard from cost-only to a 5-tab observability surface,
reading from existing JSONL run logs, eval logs, memory dirs, dream
manifests, goal files, and outcome run records.

- Activity Pulse (activity.html): last 50 runs, recent failures, recent
  captures/tool_calls/delegations/dreams, lock state. Daily check-in.
- Quality Trends (quality.html): eval score trends per agent, hard-fail
  occurrences, factual accuracy, pending tuning proposals queue, helper
  provenance health. Weekly review.
- Memory Snapshot (memory.html): note counts by type per agent,
  staleness candidates, orphan check, version-churn leaders, dream
  history, memory size + growth ratio. Monthly review.
- Goals & Outcomes (goals.html): active goals, sub-goal grid,
  blocked-sub-goal operator queue, recent outcome runs, iteration
  histogram. Conditionally rendered — only if any agent has a goal.md.

All tabs match the existing dashboard's visual vocabulary: self-contained
HTML, inline CSS, no JS deps, no external assets. Nav bar at the top of
every page links the five tabs (Goals omitted when empty).

New: atomic_agents/dashboard/{activity,quality,memory,goals,_shared}.py.
render.py + serve.py extended to wire nav and routes. CLI gains --tab
filter for fast single-tab regen during iteration.

Spec/09 extended with "The five tabs" section.

55 new tests, 557 total, all green.

Co-authored-by: Dan Powers <dep0we@gm
